name: ElegantFin TV
description: TV theme with reduced effects and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Add TV-only comparison modes for reference, theme, adapter and complete setup; manual remote-triggered measurements with hidden overlay, total long-task time and bounded image dimension samples. Desktop CSS is unchanged.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
